title: taxus pedunculata
intro: Taxus pedunculata, commonly known as Himalayan yew, is a species of evergreen tree within the Taxaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and anticancer properties. The therapeutic actions of Taxus pedunculata are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, inhibit cell proliferation, and exhibit antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents of Taxus pedunculata include taxol, taxane diterpenes, and other taxoid compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
